text_block_list.text: Whoa...!? Just how many did you get?!
choice_data_list:
How does it feel to actually hold a Paka 
Petit?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She really is cute, isn't she? It really 
captures her expressions and charm.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, but I guess today's biggest takeaway 
is finding out you're seriously good at 
video games.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So this is just a "what if" kind of thing, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Next time we come... if a new version of 
me is out. You have to win it for me, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll show you what I've got, enough to 
earn myself a brand-new Paka Petit 
figure."
